小鸟高兴得在树上唱歌 is grammatical: 得 + a result clause (cf. 高兴得跳起来). Key 地 is the intended manner reading, but 得 is also defensible, so two particles work. Drop or rewrite, e.g. "小鸟高兴＿唱着歌" with 得 impossible, or use a stem where only 地 fits (e.g. 小鸟快乐地唱歌 with the next clause).
Explain claims 自 and 曰 look like 白 and "都有「白」". Only 百 contains 白; 自 and 曰 do not. Correct to: 自 and 曰 look similar to 白 (share a box shape) but do not contain it.
